answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a stake bonded to a hardware-rooted identity, so a new agent posts real collateral before its votes count. Each extra sock-puppet needs its own audited device and the same stake, and duplicate clusters get slashed as one group. Fake peers become a ripple of costly, traceable commitments, pushing the attacker's cost per vote above any profit. Real operators reach that zenith only through genuine work. Honest contributors harvest steady nectar of rewards, since Sybil accounts burn capital faster than they earn it.
